frameworks.short: Budget your 168-hour week like money: life first, work gets the rest

outputs.map.md: Three weeks of mapped reality (what the week actually looks like) before any optimising
outputs.budget.md: The current weekly budget, category by category, and the current season
outputs.weeks/YYYY-Www.md: Weekly audit: budget vs actuals, which categories were robbed, hours lost

frameworks.short: Actions × Inputs → Outputs → Outcome: plan backwards, fix purpose when nothing moves

outputs.<outcome-slug>.md: One chain per outcome: outcome → outputs needed → actions → inputs (missing inputs are the to-do list), plus re-edits after acting

frameworks.cadence: when a goal is set, a playbook is copied, or progress stalls

frameworks.short: Goals as present-tense states of being ("I am…"), read daily

outputs.declarations.md: The declaration document, in the user's own words. Written only after the user says yes to the wording
outputs.reviews/YYYY-MM-DD.md: Anchor audits: which declarations show movement, which are gaps, the fix list

frameworks.cadence: daily read, reviewed monthly or quarterly

frameworks.short: A card for every live opportunity: context, BANT, next step, tied to a person

outputs.filter.md: The user's deal filter: this season's rules every opportunity is run through
outputs.cards/<person>--<deal>.md: One card per opportunity, linked to the person's page in relationships/people/

frameworks.cadence: whenever a conversation contains an opportunity
